messages:
Aisha (hw-partner): quick sync - vendors asked to confirm driver/firmware sign-off for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Public marketplace push targeted mid-April. Need firm embargo dates by EOD Monday. @Marco?
Marco (partnerships): NVIDIA wants embargo to Apr 18 in writing; AMD comfortable with Apr 9; Gaudi team says microcode candidate Apr 11 may change. If we hold for all we risk slipping. Options: staggered SKUs, soft-GA for some, or delay full GA.
DevBot: CI alert - marketplace-image build #512 failed on MI300 smoke: "module init error: version mismatch". Logs: https://ci.internal/512
Lena (sw-integrations): MI300 failure is a kernel-module ABI mismatch vs our staging kernel. I can run a vendor kernel image if provided; need ~48h. Suggest tag MI300/Gaudi as "early-access" and proceed H100/H200/B200 if they pass.
Jon (sre): regional capacity note - NA region can host H100/H200 first; APAC needs confirmation for Gaudi power profiles.
Sam (product): roadmap comms already say "April". Marketing needs decision by Apr 10 to prepare assets. Priya?
Priya (marketing): If staggered, we prefer messaging: "Initial GA: H100/H200/B200; early access: MI300/Gaudi" to avoid confusion in marketplace tiles.
Marco (partnerships): proposed mini-runbook: Apr 6: vendor embargo final (Aisha); Apr 7-9: SI smoke + CI (Lena + eng-release); Apr 10: decision call (Marco); Apr 11-14: marketplace bake + docs freeze (eng-release + Priya).
Aisha (hw-partner): I'll push vendors for kernel blobs and written embargo windows today.
Lena (sw-integrations): please drop kernel links here; I'll spin parallel runners.
Sam (product): decision leaning: staggered with GA for H100/H200/B200, MI300/Gaudi early access. Anyone object? React w/ :thumbsup: to agree, :thumbsdown: to block.
Aisha (hw-partner): :thumbsup:
Marco (partnerships): :thumbsup:
Lena (sw-integrations): :thumbsup:
Jon (sre): :thumbsup:
Priya (marketing): :thumbsup:
Marco (partnerships): OK consensus. I'll schedule Apr 10 9am PT decision, draft embargo-safe pre-announce for partners/legal. Thanks all.
